info.name: WorldCat Entity Data Bibliographic Resources Manage Bibliographic Records API

params.name: validationLevel
params.description: Level at which to validate records

items.docs: Given a Bibliographic record, apply the validation rules that conform to MARC standards.

info.name: Retrieve the current OCLC Numbers from WorldCat.

params.name: oclcNumbers
params.description: One or more OCLC numbers. Separated by comma if providing multiple.

items.docs: Given one or more OCLC Numbers, check WorldCat for those numbers. It will return the most current OCLC Number(s) associated w/ the OCLC Number(s) provided. If an OCLC Number does not exist or is invalid, a result of null is returned for the requested number.
Given a bibliographic record, create it in WorldCat... if it does not exist.

params.name: oclcNumber
params.description: The OCLC number of the Bibliographic record

items.docs: Given an OCLC Number, retrieve a Bibliographic record, if it exists in WorldCat.

params.name: oclcNumber
params.description: The OCLC number associated with the Bibliographic record to be replaced.

items.docs: Given an OCLC Number, replace a Bibliographic record.  If the Bibliographic record does not exist, then a new Bibliographic record will be created.

Given a Bibliographic record in textual MARC or MARCXML format, apply OCLC matching rules to provide a single best-matched WorldCat result if possible. Bibliographic input record must contain a minimum of a MARC 008 and a MARC 245 field. In the JSON response, numberOfRecords indicates the potentially matched number of records and briefRecords contains the single best-match as determined by the OCLC matching service.
